courses.title: Deep Relaxation Classes (Yoga Nidra)
courses.description: Extended Yoga Nidra sessions of 45 minutes to an hour and a half, held through the year in Melbourne for groups, individuals, workplaces, homes and conferences. Guided deep relaxation rests between waking and sleep, for easing stress, strain and pain.

left_out: The 'Anxiety and stress' page: an article, not an offering or free resource; it also frames anxiety disorders, panic attacks and depression with 'believe you can get well and you will be well', which reads close to a treatment claim. Not restored.
flags: Deep Relaxation Classes: the page shows no price or dates ('held throughout the year'); relaxation 'to manage stress, strain and pain' is wellbeing language, kept under the new rule.
